description: This file defines the HL7InQueue class, representing an HL7 message that is queued for processing within the OpenMRS platform. It extends HL7QueueItem and includes fields for queue ID, error messages, message state, and constructors for various initialization scenarios. The class is part of the org.openmrs.hl7 package and is annotated with @Audited for Hibernate Envers integration.

classes.name: HL7InQueue
classes.description: Represents an HL7 message identified as queued for processing, including status and error info. It extends HL7QueueItem and is annotated for auditing.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the HL7 queue entry.

methods.name: setHL7InQueueId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the HL7 queue entry.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with this queue entry, if any.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the error message associated with this queue entry.

methods.name: getMessageState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the message, such as pending, error, processed, etc.

methods.name: setMessageState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the message.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method to return the HL7InQueueId, making it compatible with OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method to assign the HL7InQueueId.
